1: An old man is hit head-on by a speeding car, and just when everyone thinks he is dead, his broken fingers begin to straighten one by one.
2: As the man casually gets back up with white steam rising from his body, could the superhero thought to have died twenty-five years ago actually be the neighborhood garbage man?
3: Long ago in Granite City, there were superhuman twin brothers whose home was set on fire by residents terrified of their immense power.
4: After their parents burned to death, the brothers took different paths, with Samaritan choosing justice and Nemesis choosing revenge.
5: Wielding a hammer forged from hatred, Nemesis clashed with his brother at the power plant before both vanished in a massive explosion.
6: Twenty-five years later, thirteen-year-old Sam still believes in the legend while his mother Tiffany falls behind on rent despite working day and night.
7: Sam secretly keeps an eye on Joe, an elderly garbage man who lives in the apartment across the street.
8: Every dawn, Joe rides his garbage truck around the neighborhood, finding joy in picking up and fixing the junk others have thrown away.
9: With an eviction notice taped to their front door, Sam's family could be thrown out at any moment.
10: Sam speaks to Joe for the first time as the old man carries away a broken radio.
11: Desperate for money, Sam and his friend sneak into an empty building to strip out copper wiring.
12: The two boys happily race off with their cart full of wire, though the only place that will buy it is a scrapyard run by a gang.
13: When Sam goes to sell the stolen wire out of desperation for cash, he catches the eye of a local gang led by their boss, Cyrus.
14: Having expected four hundred dollars, Sam is dumbfounded when the scrapyard owner offers a mere forty.
15: Tasked by the gang to act as a distraction, Sam collapses outside a convenience store pretending to be hurt that night while the gang robs the place.
16: When the stolen boxes turn out to contain nothing but hot sauce, Reza shifts the blame onto Sam as their boss Cyrus watches from above.
17: Spotting a drawing of Samaritan in Sam's notebook, Cyrus claims that Nemesis was the real hero instead.
18: When Sam pays the overdue rent with the money Cyrus handed him, his mother asks where he got the cash.
19: Meanwhile, Cyrus has been smuggling weapons out of a decommissioned military base to prepare for something big.
20: Harboring a grudge against Sam, Reza and his crew corner the boy in an alley.
21: Just then, old Joe appears, taking down the attacking gang members with his bare hands and even snapping Reza's knife in his grip.
22: After picking up the bent knife, Sam looks through his telescope and spots a massive burn scar on Joe's back.
23: Creeping quietly up to Joe's front door, Sam sees that the walls inside his room are completely covered with clippings about Samaritan.
24: Meanwhile, Cyrus disguises himself as a police officer to sneak into the evidence room and claims Nemesis's mask and hammer, which had been locked away for twenty-five years.
25: Sam visits a bookstore owner named Albert, a self-proclaimed Samaritan expert, who shows him a photo of the hammer found at the power plant that day.
26: At that same moment, Joe is sitting with a magnifying glass, quietly repairing an old object.
27: Although Albert refuses to believe him in the end, Sam grows even more convinced when he sees Joe waving from outside the window.
28: Needing firmer proof, Sam climbs through the window while Joe is away and leaves with a scrapbook filled entirely with articles about Samaritan.
29: Sitting inside a car, Reza glares at Joe walking through the rain, recognizing him as the very old man his cousin had ratted out.
30: Soaked to the bone, Joe returns home only to realize that his cherished scrapbook is missing.
31: The next day, Joe knocks on the door of Sam's apartment.
32: Following him outside, Sam asks if he is really Samaritan, but Joe flatly replies that he is just an old man who picks up trash.
33: At that very moment, Reza and his crew ram their car straight into Joe.
34: With his body overheating, Joe immediately looks for water and devours a whole tub of ice cream back at home, explaining that his heart will explode if he doesn't cool down after getting hurt.
35: Sam confesses that Joe once lectured his car-thief father instead of turning him in to the police, adding that his dad is no longer alive.
36: That night, Cyrus and his gang set off bombs in the middle of the street before Cyrus climbs atop a tow truck wearing Nemesis's mask.
37: As an angry crowd rallies around the fake Nemesis raising his hammer high, the city is instantly plunged into a riot.
38: At the same time, Joe wakes from a nightmare of flames with an unreadable shadow cast over his face.
39: Sam follows Joe everywhere, trailing behind him both on the bus and outside the pawnshop.
40: To Sam's disappointment, Joe simply apologizes and walks away even when a man picks a fight with him in front of the pawnshop.
41: Walking together down the night streets, Sam presses Joe for stories of his past exploits and asks if he has ever felt fear.
42: Before they part ways, Joe takes Sam's broken wristwatch and promises to try fixing it.
43: As the news reports daily on the return of Nemesis, Joe silently eats his cereal without a word.
44: The next day, Sam begs Joe to teach him how to fight, leading to their first lesson up on the rooftop.
45: When Sam throws a surprise punch, it is his own hand that ends up hurting instead.
46: Joe explains that he repairs junk because even old, worn-out things deserve a second chance.
47: However, the moment Sam brings up Nemesis, Joe's expression hardens completely.
48: After Sam leaves feeling practically chased out, Cyrus pulls up in his car and asks if he wants to do a hundred-dollar job.
49: At the hideout, a girl named Sil looks after Sam and tells him that she is an orphan too, making Cyrus her only family.
50: While sharing french fries with Sam at the gang's hideout, Sil is kind to him but doesn't forget to offer a word of warning.
51: Cyrus assigns Sam to keep watch, a simple task that only requires him to whistle if the police show up.
52: When Sam fails to even let out a whistle, Cyrus smoothly steps in and talks the police into leaving himself.
53: From his hiding spot, Sam secretly watches as a man is dragged out of a car trunk.
54: While Sam was keeping watch, the gang brought in a power plant worker who had stopped them from planting bombs, and Cyrus forces him to stand before a massive industrial shredder.
55: Watching from hiding as Cyrus pretends to spare the begging man's life, Sam freezes in horror at his sheer cruelty.
56: While trying to run away, Sam is caught by Reza's crew and beaten until he loses consciousness.
57: Spotting the gang wheeling the unconscious boy away in a cart, Joe takes Sam to the hospital, only for Sam's mother to lash out at him coldly.
58: Meanwhile, Cyrus hears rumors about an old man who walked away unscathed after being hit by a car.
59: As Joe walks down the street, Cyrus's henchmen begin trailing behind him one by one.
60: Surrounded under an overpass by Cyrus's men who threaten him to come along, Joe sends them flying into the walls one after another.
61: A gunman is knocked to the ground in an instant while the people in the homeless encampment can only stare in shock.
62: When a remaining henchman charges forward in a car, Joe shields a young girl in his arms and stops the vehicle in its tracks.
63: The entire scene is caught on camera, and the news soon erupts with stories that Samaritan has returned.
64: As police sirens begin to wail in the distance, Joe hurriedly slips away from the scene.
65: Sam begs Joe for help because Cyrus is plotting something at the power plant, but Joe is already packing his bags out of fear that his identity has been exposed.
66: Watching the same news broadcast, Cyrus realizes that if the real Samaritan has returned, he will definitely try to stand in his way.
67: Heavily armed gang members head to Joe's apartment, and although Joe has already left, they spot Sam inside his place instead.
68: Storming toward Joe's apartment, the gang fires a hail of bullets through the windows.
69: Sam flees with his mother in the elevator, but the gang is already rushing up the stairs to intercept them.
70: Chased all the way to the roof with his mother, Sam is dragged away after Sil knocks his mom down as she tries to protect her son.
71: At that moment, Joe stands before an outbound city bus, but with Sam's words echoing in his ears, he ultimately refuses to board.
72: Arriving at Sam's apartment with the repaired watch, Joe learns from the boy's battered mother that Sam has been taken away.
73: Joe climbs into his garbage truck and drives straight toward Cyrus's hideout at full speed.
74: Through the dark of night, Joe switches on the garbage truck's headlights and barrels toward the hideout.
75: As the gang unleashes a barrage of bullets, the garbage truck smashes straight through the wall of the building.
76: Bullets rain down on Joe after he crashes through the wall, but he walks out and takes the gunmen down one by one.
77: Stepping out of the overturned truck amidst the sparks, Joe grabs the gang members and hurls them aside one after another.
78: Then Cyrus pulls out Nemesis's hammer, the only weapon capable of hurting the superhuman twins.
79: Struck down to his knees by the hammer, Joe lifts his bleeding head and utters something completely unexpected.
80: Just then, an explosion rips through the hideout as Joe seizes the hammer and wipes out the gang, while Cyrus puts on Nemesis's mask and orders the power plant to be blown up.
81: Gripping the hammer, Joe marches toward the gang without stopping even as bullets fly straight at him.
82: With the hammer resting on his shoulder, Joe walks slowly into the burning building.
83: Wearing the mask, Cyrus lowers his head as though he has truly become Nemesis.
84: As a blackout plunges the entire city into darkness, Joe and Cyrus clash one final time inside the flame-engulfed building.
85: Flames spread across the streets while rioters march onward carrying torches.
86: The chaos reaches the front of Albert's pawnshop as people's screams echo from the burning buildings.
87: Struck in the chest by the hammer, Joe collapses as his body overheats while Cyrus laughs at him in mockery.
88: After falling through the collapsing floor, Joe barely manages to crawl back up, only to find Cyrus waiting for him.
89: Joe finally strikes Cyrus down with a steel pipe as memories of that fateful night twenty-five years ago come flooding back.
90: The truth is that Samaritan was the one who died that day, and his surviving younger brother Nemesis has been living in hiding under his brother's name ever since.
91: Having defeated Cyrus, Joe hurls Nemesis's mask into the fiery pit.
92: When Joe loses consciousness from overheating, Sam redirects water from a burst pipe to cool his body down.
93: After Joe leaps from the collapsing building with Sam in his arms, the boy cautiously asks him a question.
94: Bombarded with questions by reporters after being rescued, Sam decides to keep Joe's secret safe.
95: As the watch Joe repaired ticks away on Sam's wrist, the old man vanishes unnoticed into the darkness.
96: This was Amazon MGM's *Samaritan*, directed by Julius Avery and featuring a seventy-something Sylvester Stallone performing his own action scenes.
97: In a story reminding us that both good and evil exist within everyone's heart, please leave a comment below on whether you would have kept Joe's secret if you were in Sam's shoes.
